adapt_config_dict: adapt a Mistral-style config dict into a Hugging Face PretrainedConfig with remapped keys and defaults
remap_general_mistral_args: remap Mistral-style config keys to Hugging Face transformer config keys like hidden_size and num_attention_heads
remap_mistral_sliding_window: convert Mistral sliding_window list format into HF-compatible layer_types and sliding window int
remap_mistral_yarn_args: convert Mistral YaRN RoPE parameters into HF rope_parameters format with proper type casting
remap_mistral_audio_args: convert Mistral multimodal audio config into a Voxtral audio_config with WhisperConfig parameters
